name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Command — Tree Navigator & Point Sandbox
features: Search all official returned class/spec/hero nodes by name or node ID, with allocated and source-linked views.
Jump directly to a node in the original tree canvas, select the correct tab, and inspect existing rank-specific source descriptions.
Explore up to 18 levels of returned upstream locked_by links without assuming they are mandatory game prerequisites.
Preview adding or removing one rank, with a read-only before/after point and source advisory count; apply only through original native talent controls and undo history.
Highlight immediate reported links from a selected skill directly on Blizzard-positioned tree nodes, with per-node relationship badges.
Keep mobile-specific layout, saved builds, auth isolation, official artwork, user backup format, and four deterministic bundles.
